findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler cannot be constructed
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler and implements none of its abstract methods (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data). It is still assigned as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler. Detector.detector_handler instantiates that class, so any detector whose type slug resolves to MetricAlertFire raises TypeError instead of evaluating. Previously this handler was concrete and evaluate() returned an empty list.

findings.title: Group-key evaluation test expects the wrong occurrence
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds the expected IssueOccurrence via build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, ...) but then calls evaluate_group_key_value("group_key", 10, ...). Production calls build_occurrence_and_event_data with group_key "group_key" and value 10, so the fingerprint (and any value-derived fields) will not match the expected result. The assertion is wrong and will fail if IssueOccurrence equality includes those fields, and it does not lock the new hook's arguments.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but its docstring still says it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult. Callers reading the docstring will use the old contract that this PR intentionally removed.
